name: swift-pbi
description: Power BI as code, in conversation. Prototype a semantic model for your own data and hand engineers a spec; explain TMDL lint findings; plan how to bring client models in line with one template. Running the four command-line tools needs a local shell; in ChatGPT the skills interview, write specs and read pasted tool output.

interface.longDescription: Prototype a Power BI semantic model in conversation, lint TMDL, bring client models back in line with a template, and keep report charts consistent. Command-line tools run in a local shell; in ChatGPT, the skills interview, write specifications and explain tool output you provide.
defaultPrompt: Help me prototype a data model for our repair bookings.
Lint this PBIP folder and tell me why it will not open.
Which client models drifted from the template?
